arxiv-2209-01409.title: Dust Reverberation Mapping and Light-Curve Modelling of Zw229-015 2022 Dust Reverberation Mapping and Light-Curve Modelling of Zw229-015 – C.3.2
arxiv-2209-01409.creator: E. Guise, S. F. Hönig, V. Gorjian, A. J. Barth, T. Almeyda, L. Pei, S. B. Cenko, R. Edelson, A. V. Filippenko, M. D. Joner, C. D. Laney, W. Li, M. A. Malkan, M. L. Nguyen, W. Zheng
arxiv-2209-01409.description: Abstract Multiwavelength variability studies of active galactic nuclei (AGN) can be used to probe their inner regions which are not directly resolvable. Dust reverberation mapping (DRM) estimates the size of the dust emitting region by measuring the delays between the infrared (IR) response to variability in the optical light curves.

arxiv-2302-10672.title: Importance of methodological choices in data manipulation for validating epileptic seizure detection models Thanks: This work has been partially supported by the ML-Edge Swiss National Science Foundation (NSF) Research project (GA No. 200020182009/1), and the PEDESITE Swiss NSF Sinergia project (GA
arxiv-2302-10672.creator: Una Pale 1 , Tomas Teijeiro 1 2 , David Atienza 1
arxiv-2302-10672.description: Abstract Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder that affects a significant portion of the human population and imposes serious risks in the daily life of patients. Despite advances in machine learning and IoT, small, nonstigmatizing wearable devices for continuous monitoring and detection in outpatient environments are not yet available.

arxiv-2302-11024.title: Gradient Flows for Sampling: Mean-Field Models, Gaussian Approximations and Affine Invariance
arxiv-2302-11024.creator: Yifan Chen 2,1, Daniel Zhengyu Huang 3,1, Jiaoyang Huang 4, Sebastian Reich 5, Andrew M. Stuart 1
arxiv-2302-11024.description: Abstract . Sampling a probability distribution with an unknown normalization constant is a fundamental problem in computational science and engineering. This task may be cast as an optimization problem over all probability measures, and an initial distribution can be evolved to the desired minimizer (the target distribution) dynamically via gradient flows.

arxiv-2306-17538.title: Beyond Active Engagement: The Significance of Lurkers in a Polarized Twitter Debate
arxiv-2306-17538.creator: Anees Baqir, Yijing Chen, Fernando Diaz-Diaz, Sercan Kiyak, Thomas Louf, Virginia Morini, Valentina Pansanella, Maddalena Torricelli, Alessandro Galeazzi
arxiv-2306-17538.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anees Baqir, Yijing Chen, Fernando Diaz-Diaz, Sercan Kiyak, Thomas Louf, Virginia Morini, Valentina Pansanella, Maddalena Torricelli, Alessandro Galeazzi. The emergence of new public forums in the shape of online social media has introduced unprecedented challenges to public discourse, including polarization, misinformation, and the emergence of echo chambers. While existing research has extensively studied the behavior of active users within echo chambers, little attention has been given to the hidden audience, also known as lurkers, who passively consume content without actively engaging.

arxiv-2307-15797.title: Electronic transport and thermoelectricity in selenospinel Cu 6-x Fe 4+x Sn 12 Se 32
arxiv-2307-15797.creator: Yu Liu, 1,∗ Zhixiang Hu, 1,2 Xiao Tong, 3 David Graf, 4 and C. Petrovic 1,2
arxiv-2307-15797.description: Abstract We report a study of selenospinel Cu 6-x Fe 4+x Sn 12 Se 32 ( x x = 0, 1, 2) single crystals, which crystalize in a cubic structure with the F ​ d ​ 3 ¯ ​ m Fd\overline{3}m space group, and show typical semiconducting behavior.

arxiv-2505-06234.title: The Largest Circle Enclosing n n Lattice Points
arxiv-2505-06234.creator: Jianqiang Zhao
arxiv-2505-06234.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we propose a class of elementary plane geometry problems closely related to the title of this paper. Here, a circle is the 1-dimensional curve bounding a disk. For any nonnegative integer, a circle is called n -enclosing if it contains exactly n lattice points on the xy -plane in its interior.

arxiv-2508-05490.title: Phonon-blocked junction calorimeter
arxiv-2508-05490.creator: Zhuoran Geng, Joel Hätinen, Emma Mykkänen, Mika Prunnila, Ilari J. Maasilta
arxiv-2508-05490.description: Abstract This study introduces a cold-electron microcalorimeter based on phonon-blocked junctions, integrating on-chip electron cooling and boundary phonon isolation to achieve exceptional energy resolution and rapid thermal response. A general theoretical framework is presented, along with derived approximate analytical expressions for key performance metrics, including cooling efficiency, thermal time constant, and energy resolution.

pmc-10693128.title: Aging gene signature of memory CD8+ T cells is associated with neurocognitive functioning in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-10693128.creator: Juan Joseph Young, Hong-Jai Park, Minhyung Kim, Jennefer Par-Young, Hugh Bartlett, Hye Sun Kim, Serhan Unlu, Lais Osmani, Min Sun Shin, Richard Bucala, Christopher H van Dyck, Heather Allore, Adam P Mecca, Sungyong You, Insoo Kang
pmc-10693128.description: BackgroundMemory CD8+ T cells expand with age. We previously demonstrated an age-associated expansion of effector memory (EM) CD8+ T cells expressing low levels of IL-7 receptor alpha (IL-7Rαlow) and the presence of its gene signature (i.e., IL-7Rαlow aging genes) in peripheral blood of older adults without Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

pmc-12451272.title: Risk of Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis Following HPV9 Vaccination: A Retrospective Cohort Study Before and During the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-12451272.creator: Ming-Chin Tsai, Hsin-Hua Chen, Wen-Yu Wu, Yung-Chieh Huang, Chiann-Yi Hsu, Lin-Shien Fu
pmc-12451272.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate whether 9-valent human papillomavirus (HPV9) vaccination is associated with an increased risk of juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), particularly during the coronavirus disease-2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.Patients and MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study using TriNetX U.S. Collaborative Network data from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2023.

pmc-12465693.title: Combining dynamic generalized linear models and mechanistic modelling to optimize treatment strategies against bovine respiratory disease
pmc-12465693.creator: Carolina Merca, Baptiste Sorin-Dupont, Anders Ringgaard Kristensen, Sébastien Picault, Sébastien Assié, Pauline Ezanno
pmc-12465693.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Bovine respiratory disease (BRD) is a major health challenge for young bulls. To minimize economic losses, collective treatments have been widely adopted. Nevertheless, performing collective treatments involves a trade-off between BRD cumulative incidence and severity, and antimicrobial usage (AMU). Therefore, we propose a proof-of-concept of a decision support tool aimed at helping farmers and veterinarians make informed decisions about the appropriate timing for performing collective treatment for BRD.

pmc-12717716.title: T cell KAT6A deficiency relieves inflammatory bowel disease in mice
pmc-12717716.creator: Shi-Jia Huang, Hui-Lin Ye, Shuo Xu, Ting Liu, Wu-Chang Zhang, Yong-Li Wang, Sheng-Zhong Duan
pmc-12717716.description: The incidence of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) has been increasing, and while the interaction between T cells and intestinal microorganisms is crucial in its pathogenesis, the related epigenetic mechanisms remain unclear. This study found that the expression of lysine acetyltransferase 6A (KAT6A) was increased in T cells of patients with acute colitis.

pmc-13185648.title: Top five Alzheimer Disease trial eligibility criteria favor men compared to women in a clinic-based cohort
pmc-13185648.creator: Lieza G. Exalto, Siti S. Syaziyah, Xiaotian T Fang, Niels D. Prins, Sietske A.M. Sikkes, Wiesje M. van der Flier, Everard G.B. Vijverberg, Yvonne M.F. Lim
pmc-13185648.description: Highlights•Eligibility criteria of 608 AD drug trials were extracted and harmonized.•Women in our cohort are less eligible after applying top 5 AD clinical trial eligibility criteria.•Absence of a caregiver and lower MMSE are the main reasons for exclusion of women. Background Fewer women participate in Alzheimer Disease (AD) trials than their representation in the general dementia population.

pmc-13264323.title: Transcriptional response of spermathecal secretory cells to mating and receipt of seminal fluid proteins in Aedes aegypti
pmc-13264323.creator: Claudia A.S. Wyer, Mehrnaz Afkhami, David A. Ellis, Sylvie Pitcher, I. Alexandra Amaro, Patrick K. Perish, Jake W. Angelico, Emilie M. Gray, Yasir H. Ahmed-Braimah, Mariana F. Wolfner, Laura C. Harrington
pmc-13264323.description: SummaryAedes aegypti mosquitos are major vectors of arboviruses including dengue, yellow fever, Zika, and chikungunya, highlighting the need for innovative control strategies. Females typically mate only once yet store sufficient sperm to produce hundreds of offspring over their lifetime. During mating, males transfer sperm and seminal fluid proteins from the male accessory glands (MAGs) into the female reproductive tract.

pmc-13335212.title: Evaluation of nursing snippet-based intervention on parents’ burden and self-efficacy towards caring for their children undergoing limb lengthening surgery
pmc-13335212.creator: Rawia Abd El-Ghany Mohamed, Nora Abd El-Alim Ebrahim, Hanan Elsayed Metwally
pmc-13335212.description: BackgroundThe intricacy of pin-site care and fixator modification makes caring for children having limb lengthening surgery extremely taxing on parents. Their self-efficacy, which is essential for positive postoperative results, is frequently lowered by this stress. Traditional teaching approaches might not be able to offer the ongoing assistance required to preserve caregiver confidence and lower stress levels.

pmc-13359801.title: Adjunct Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy for Refractory Infections in Patients with Hematologic Malignancies: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-13359801.creator: Kunhwa Kim, Dimitrios P. Kontoyiannis, Hycienth Ahaneku, Deborah McCue, Javier Adachi, Alessandra Ferrajoli
pmc-13359801.description: Simple SummaryHyperbaric oxygen therapy, a procedure that increases the level of oxygen circulating in the body, is sometimes used in specialized centers in addition to surgery and antimicrobial therapy to help fight infection and improve healing of infectious lesions in patients affected by hematological malignancies.

pmc-13475222.title: What Resources Are Available for Parents Online? A Readability, Quality, and Source Evaluation of Website and AI-Generated Content on Inherited Pediatric Orthopaedic Conditions
pmc-13475222.creator: Daniel S. Hayes, Elizabeth H. Blank, Ryan D. Muchow
pmc-13475222.description: BackgroundIndividuals frequently consult the internet when seeking information about their health. However, patient education materials (PEMs) published online are often written above the recommended sixth-to eighth-grade reading level. The readability and quality of online resources for inherited conditions are poorly studied.
